opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot email
opportunities.description: For a country, look up GDP/growth/population on World Bank and capital/currency on Wikipedia, then draft an email to a recipient with a macro snapshot summary (then discard).
steps: Search the country name in World Bank data search
Search the country on Wikipedia and read capital and currency
Type summary body with GDP, growth, population, capital, currency
